mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: The tail grows longer as the froglet becomes an adult.

intelligence.enrichment: A frog begins as eggs in a jelly-like mass, progresses through embryo and tadpole stages, develops legs while still having a tail, becomes a froglet, and then becomes an adult frog. Development changes body structures and habitat use over time: tadpoles use tails to swim in water, froglets still live in water but start coming onto land, and the froglet changes into an adult. The learner correctly applies this rule: A frog begins as eggs in a jelly-like mass, progresses through embryo and tadpole stages, develops legs while still having a tail, becomes a froglet, and then becomes an adult frog. Once a frog young has legs, it is already an adult frog.
